test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.

The __train was already left__ before we reached the platform.
solution:
The correct answer is '**train had left already**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **most appropriate** substitute for the underlined segment is '**train had already left**'.
 
• The given sentence, considering the timing, should be in **Past Perfect tense**.
 
• The **structure **of the Past Perfect tense is:
 
 
• **Subject + had + V3 + Object.**
 
 
 
• So, the **correct formation** of the given sentence should be '**The train had already left before we reached the platform**.'
